name: Microsoft Teams meeting transcription
short_description: The Microsoft Teams feature that creates a live, speaker-attributed transcript of a meeting; Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams relies on it to produce meeting summaries and action items.

evidence.quote: If your team set up blocks transcription for compliance reasons, Copilot won't be able to generate consistent summaries
you won't get the useful recap unless transcription is on in the first place. No transcript, no copilot memory
